description: This PHP source file defines an in-memory fake class for CalendarAccountValidator used for testing purposes. It replaces database-backed validation with in-memory storage of account data, allowing validation logic without external dependencies. It provides methods for adding valid accounts, validating accounts by ID, and clearing stored accounts.

classes.name: InMemoryCalendarAccountValidator
classes.description: A test double class that simulates calendar account validation using in-memory storage, suitable for unit tests.

methods.name: addValidAccount
methods.description: Adds a CalendarAccount object to the in-memory store after validating that required fields are not empty.

methods.name: validateCalendarAccount
methods.description: Validates and retrieves a CalendarAccount by its ID from in-memory storage; throws exceptions if the ID is invalid or not found.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all stored valid accounts from the in-memory store.
